analysis: The trial completed successfully with host-evaluated macro validation HR@10 of 0.5575 across all four datasets: Movies_and_TV 0.565, Industrial_and_Scientific 0.595, Electronics 0.455, and CDs_and_Vinyl 0.615. Allocated GPU time was 1,230.85 seconds. Single-user validation and strict reload comparisons using identical deployed inputs passed. This confirms the revised pipeline runs successfully, but does not establish the previous crash’s root cause or isolate which change improved reliability. Electronics remains the weakest category.
code_summary: Trains two independent experts per dataset with seed 42: a 96-dimensional attentive item-similarity model with two causal attention blocks, learned recency weights, and a gated sequential readout; and a baseline-style SASRec model using next-item binary cross-entropy. Each expert selects its checkpoint by validation HR@10, with NDCG@10 breaking ties. Deployment averages the experts’ candidate ranks, resolving raw-score ties by item ID and assigning duplicates identical ranks. The predictor writer reloads both trained architectures, retains all four dataset routes, and shares inference logic with validation. Training includes category deadlines, an 8.5-hour allowance cap, and traceback logging.
